_comment: Coverage floors (percent) per module, checked by `pixi run coverage` (tools/ci/coverage.py): clang source-based
line and branch coverage of src/<module>/ (module unit tests excluded) by the hermetic tests.
Floors only go up: each is the measured value minus 2, rounded down to 0.1 (stub modules 0). A PR that raises
a module's coverage may raise its floors; a slice PR that extends a module sets them again from its measurement.
Long-term targets (lines / branches): common, sql and plan 90 / 75; io, exec and engine 85 / 70; cli 60 / 40.
Measured 2026-09-25 after the exec/engine/cli slice (lines / branches): common 94.94 / 92.86, sql 99.38 / 97.67,
(cli keeps its higher earlier line floor).
A module without branches (or lines) is N/A for that floor.
